run_evaluate_meeting_planning: run the evaluation script to compute accuracy of meeting planning model predictions against golden plans
create_validator_from_text: create a validator that computes the number of valid meetings scheduled in a text-format meeting plan
create_validator_from_dict: create a validator that computes valid meetings from a JSON-format meeting plan with structured step dictionaries
create_process_constraints: create a function that parses raw meeting constraints into structured dictionaries with location, time windows, and meeting durations
create_parse_text_plan: create a function that parses a text meeting plan string into a list of individual step strings
